journey.name: import preview friend count
journey.description: Precondition: the import preview is open for a disposable Ring identity that follows exactly one other profile. Repeat with an identity that follows exactly two profiles, and optionally ones that follow five or 21. The count uses the language's plural rules, so also repeat in Russian (Settings > General > Language).

actions.action: Verify the friend count in the import preview reads "1 friend"
Open the import preview for the identity with 2 follows and verify the count reads "2 friends"
Switch the app language to Russian, open the import preview for one follow and verify the count reads "1 друг"
Open the import preview for the identity with 2 follows and verify the count reads "2 друга"
If an identity with 5 follows is available, verify its count reads "5 друзей"; with 21 follows, "21 друг"
